포장하다.m: to wrap, to pack; to get (food) to go
포장하다.x: Please pack up the leftover food for me.

실망하다.forms: 실망해요 · 실망했어요 · 실망할 거예요 · 실망하지 마세요
실망하다.x: I was really disappointed when I saw my test results.
실망하다.t: 'Disappointed in someone' uses 한테 or 에게: 너한테 실망했어 = I'm disappointed in you.

아직도.forms: 아직도 + verb/adjective; 아직 안 = not yet
아직도.ex: 민수 씨는 그 영화를 아직도 안 봤어요?
아직도.x: Minsu, you still haven't seen that movie?
아직도.e: 아직 'still, yet' + 도 for emphasis; often sounds surprised.

방송국.ex: 제 꿈은 방송국에서 피디로 일하는 거예요.
방송국.x: My dream is to work as a producer at a broadcasting station.

요청하다.x: I got lost, so I asked the police for help.

파악하다.m: to grasp, to understand, to figure out
파악하다.x: First, we need to understand the situation accurately.
파악하다.e: Literally 'grasp and hold' something in your mind.
파악하다.t: Pronounced [파아카다]; it sounds more formal than 알다 and fits work or news contexts.

음성 메시지.ex: 친구가 전화를 안 받아서 음성 메시지를 남겼어요.
음성 메시지.x: My friend didn't answer, so I left a voicemail.
음성 메시지.t: Use 남기다 (to leave): 음성 메시지를 남기다.

소독하다.ex: 간호사가 주사를 놓기 전에 팔을 소독했어요.
소독하다.x: The nurse disinfected my arm before giving the shot.

불량품.x: The earphones I just bought were defective, so I exchanged them.
불량품.e: Literally 'not-good goods.' -품 = item, goods: 신제품, 반품.

신중하다.x: You should make important decisions carefully.

시급.x: How much is the hourly wage for this convenience store job?
시급.t: Korea's legal minimum wage (최저 임금) is set each year as an hourly rate. Homonym: 시급 'urgent' uses different hanja.

수습.x: The first three months are a probation period.
수습.e: Literally 'practice and learn' on the job.
수습.t: A different 수습 means 'bringing a situation under control', as in 사태를 수습하다.

붓기.ex: 아침에 얼굴에 붓기가 있어서 찬물로 세수했어요.
붓기.x: My face was puffy in the morning, so I washed it with cold water.
붓기.e: Speakers link it to 붓다 'to swell', but the dictionary spelling is 부기.
붓기.t: 붓기가 빠지다 means 'the swelling goes down'.

일정하다.ex: 매일 일정한 시간에 자는 것이 건강에 좋아요.
일정하다.x: Going to bed at a regular time every day is good for your health.
일정하다.t: Pronounced [일쩡하다]. Don't mix it up with the noun 일정 'schedule', which is written the same.

미덕.ex: 겸손은 한국 사회에서 큰 미덕으로 여겨져요.
미덕.x: Modesty is seen as a great virtue in Korean society.

글썽이다.m: (of eyes) to brim with tears, to well up
글썽이다.x: At my graduation, Mom's eyes welled up with tears.
글썽이다.e: Mimetic 글썽 'tears filling the eyes' + verb suffix -이다.
글썽이다.t: Usually 눈물을 글썽이다 or 눈에 눈물이 글썽이다. Same meaning: 글썽거리다.

진상.m: the truth (of a matter), the real facts
진상.x: The bereaved families demanded a full investigation into the truth of the accident.
진상.e: Literally 'the true face' of an event.
진상.t: Slang 진상 (a nightmare customer) is a different, informal use; 진상 규명 is the formal collocation.

귀농.m: returning to farming, moving from the city to farm
귀농.ex: 은퇴 후에 귀농하는 사람들이 늘고 있어요.
귀농.x: More and more people are moving to the countryside to farm after retiring.
귀농.t: 귀농 means moving to farm; 귀촌 just means moving to the countryside without farming.

존속하다.m: to continue to exist, to survive, to remain in place
존속하다.ex: 그 제도는 여러 비판에도 불구하고 지금까지 존속하고 있어요.
존속하다.x: Despite much criticism, that system still survives today.
존속하다.t: Pronounced [존소카다]. Often about institutions or organizations, not people.

야박하다.t: Often about small acts of meanness: 인심이 야박하다 'stingy with kindness'.

불쑥.ex: 회의 중에 그가 불쑥 이상한 질문을 했어요.
불쑥.x: During the meeting, he abruptly asked a strange question.
불쑥.e: A mimetic word for something popping out suddenly.

일망타진.m: rounding up (a whole gang) in one sweep
일망타진.ex: 경찰이 오랜 수사 끝에 마약 조직을 일망타진했습니다.
일망타진.x: After a long investigation, the police rounded up the entire drug ring.

동병상련.m: sympathy among fellow sufferers; misery loves company
동병상련.x: Maybe because we were in the same situation, I felt a kinship with him.
동병상련.e: Literally 'the same illness, pitying each other'.

오합지졸.m: a disorganized rabble; an undisciplined mob
오합지졸.ex: 훈련을 안 하면 우리 팀은 오합지졸에 불과해요.
오합지졸.x: Without training, our team is nothing but a disorganized rabble.
오합지졸.e: Literally 'soldiers gathered like a flock of crows.'

조립.ex: 이 책상은 혼자서도 쉽게 조립할 수 있어요.
조립.x: You can easily assemble this desk by yourself.
조립.t: 조립식 means 'prefabricated' or 'build-it-yourself', as in 조립식 가구.

절대 평가.ex: 절대 평가에서는 기준 점수만 넘으면 합격할 수 있어요.
절대 평가.x: With absolute grading, you pass as long as you exceed the cutoff score.
절대 평가.e: Literally 'absolute evaluation' — scored against a fixed standard, not classmates.

편법.ex: 그는 편법을 써서 세금을 줄이려고 했어요.
편법.x: He tried to reduce his taxes by using a shady workaround.
편법.e: Literally 'convenient method': an easy way around proper procedure.
편법.t: Usually negative: 편법을 쓰다 'to use a shortcut' implies bending the rules.

주가조작.ex: 검찰은 대규모 주가조작 사건을 수사하고 있습니다.
주가조작.x: Prosecutors are investigating a large-scale stock manipulation case.
주가조작.t: 조작 means 'rigging' (여론 조작) but also simply 'operating' a machine (기계 조작).

파킨슨병.ex: 파킨슨병에 걸리면 손이 떨리는 증상이 나타나요.
파킨슨병.x: With Parkinson's disease, symptoms like trembling hands appear.
파킨슨병.e: Named after English doctor James Parkinson, plus Korean -병 'disease'.

정성적.x: We analyzed the interview data using qualitative methods.
정성적.e: Literally 'fixing the nature' — describing qualities, not numbers.
정성적.t: Don't confuse it with 정성 (精誠), 'sincere effort', as in 정성껏 (wholeheartedly).

서평.ex: 신문에 실린 서평을 읽고 그 책을 샀어요.
서평.x: I bought that book after reading a review in the newspaper.
서평.t: 독후감 is a personal book report, usually for school; 서평 evaluates a book for other readers.

이주노동자.x: Protecting the human rights of migrant workers is an important task.
이주노동자.e: -자 = person who does it: 노동자, 소비자, 운전자.
이주노동자.t: Media increasingly prefer 이주노동자 to 외국인 노동자 as a more neutral term.

몰각하다.m: to ignore entirely, to lose sight of
몰각하다.x: That policy is armchair theorizing that completely ignores reality.
몰각하다.e: Literally 'sink and discard': losing track of something essential.

인용하다.ex: 발표할 때 전문가의 말을 인용하면 설득력이 높아져요.
인용하다.x: Quoting an expert in your presentation makes it more persuasive.
인용하다.e: Literally 'pull in and use' — borrowing someone else's words.
인용하다.t: Pronounced [이뇽하다] — ㄴ links to the next vowel.

조강지처.m: a wife who has shared hardship since poorer days
조강지처.ex: 성공한 뒤에도 그는 조강지처를 소중히 여겼어요.
조강지처.x: Even after becoming successful, he cherished the wife who had stood by him through hard times.
조강지처.e: Literally 'wife of grain dregs and husks' — she ate poor food with you.
조강지처.t: Often used in stories about men who abandon such a wife after success.
